name: go-wal-kv
title: Go write-ahead-log key/value store
blurb: A key/value HTTP service whose every write is framed, checksummed and fsynced to an append-only log before it answers.
default_description: A small key/value service that survives a hard restart.

verify.name: selftest
verify.cmd: mkdir -p build && go build -o build/{{ npm_name }} . && ./build/{{ npm_name }} --selftest

verify.name: smoke
verify.cmd: mkdir -p build && go build -o build/{{ npm_name }} . && bash smoke.sh
